    Profile

    Lil' Ouroboros is an entity that was created by Ouroboros' desire to observe humans from up close. She is a Phantom created from a fragment of Ouroboros' power, which may be why she is rather childlike in mind and body. She also tends to emulate Ouroboros' mannerisms because she idolizes her.

    Origin: ?
    Gender: Female
    Height: 127cm
    Weight: 27kg
    Birthday: ？
    Blood Type: Type A
    Zodiac: ?
    Likes: Strong-willed people, sweet food
    Hobbies: Challenging humans
    Illust: RINZO
    CV: 堀江由衣
